text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementAstronomyNASA Has Begun the Countdown to the Launch of the Nancy Grace Roman Space TelescopeThe new space telescope will help astronomers unravel the mysteries of the universeJCBy Jake Currie7:00 AM CDT on August 27, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThe mirrors are polished, the rehearsal is done, and the countdown has begun. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is scheduled for liftoff the morning of Sunday, August 30th from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoPowered By 10 Time-Lapse Of Sliver Of Cygnus Loop Nebula In Hubble TelescopeShareNextStayNamed after NASA's first Chief of Astronomy, the telescope will be putting some of her ideas into action. As early as 1959, Roman proposed that space-based telescopes could be used to detect exoplanets by blocking some of the light from stars.
